'''Mallow''' was a [[Nomai]] who worked at the [[Orbital Probe Cannon]] as part of the [[Ash Twin Project]]. They were the spouse of [[Avens]].<ref>DAZ: If I know my brother, Avens (and his spouse) will want to launch the probe with as much power as possible.</ref>

==The Ash Twin Project==
During discussions about the [[Eye of the Universe]], Mallow pointed out that they learned that the Eye is in orbit around the [[Sun]].<ref>MALLOW: Based on our knowledge of the Quantum Moon, we believe the Eye is in orbit around this star system’s sun.</ref> Since the Nomai also knew what the Eye looks like due to the [[Quantum Moon]], Mallow proposed that they should try to find the Eye visually with a probe.<ref>MALLOW: We know what the Eye looks like thanks to the Quantum Moon, so what if we try to find the Eye visually, instead? Let’s send out a probe!</ref> This eventually led to the building of the Orbital Probe Cannon. 

==Orbital Probe Cannon==
Mallow later worked with their husband, Avens, and with [[Privet]] on the Orbital Probe Cannon. Mallow and Avens were responsible for testing and adjusting the Cannon's launch power.<ref>YARROW: Our friends on Giant’s Deep tested the Orbital Probe Cannon today. Mallow tells me the cannon is doing well, and that Avens advocates for more launch power.</ref> They were both very passionate about finding the Eye of the Universe.<ref>MALLOW: The thought of concluding our elders’ curious and challenging search increases my heart’s temperature, my love!</ref> Avens' brother, [[Daz]], decided to give them a slightly lower maximum power setting than the absolute maximum to account for their enthusiasm.<ref>DAZ: I propose we give Avens and Mallow a slightly lower maximum power setting for the Cannon than the absolute maximum possible to create room for their enthusiasm.</ref> However, Mallow and Avens decided to ignore this setting to give the Orbital Probe Cannon the highest chance of finding the Eye of the Universe.<ref>AVENS: Giving the Orbital Probe Cannon all the power it can structurally withstand creates the greatest chance of finding the Eye of the universe. MALLOW: Yes, the probe must travel as fast as it can, as far as it can. I’ll make some adjustments!</ref> When discussing the Orbital Probe Cannon with Privet, Mallow told her that it did not matter if the Cannon's structural integrity was compromised, since they only needed to fire a probe once.<ref>PRIVET: You won’t ask the Orbital Probe Cannon to use so much power that it breaks, will you? MALLOW: Fret not, my nervous friend! We only need to fire the probe once, anyway, so who minds if it compromises the Orbital Probe Cannon’s structural integrity slightly?</ref> 

Mallow and Privet were both on the Orbital Probe Cannon when the Ash Twin Project was put on hold due to the [[Sun Station]] not being able to trigger a [[Supernova]].<ref>CASSAVA: I have bad news, Avens. Yarrow says there was a problem with the proposed power source, so the Orbital Probe Cannon won’t be asked to fire.</ref><ref>CASSAVA: Tell Privet and Mallow they should return from the cannon. My spouse and I will remain at the Construction Yard, for now.</ref> Avens and Mallow decided to join Daz and [[Cassava]] at the [[Construction Yard]].<ref>CASSAVA: Tell Privet and Mallow they should return from the cannon. My spouse and I will remain at the Construction Yard, for now. AVENS: An update: Mallow and I will join you and Daz.</ref>

Mallow's remains are presumably with Avens' at the Construction Yard, where they died when the [[Ghost Matter]] from the [[Interloper]] spread throughout the solar system. The adjustments that Mallow and Avens made to the launch power proved to be fatal to the Orbital Probe Cannon, which breaks apart entirely upon launch, with the [[Orbital_Probe_Cannon#Probe_Tracking_Module|Probe Tracking Module]] disappearing into [[Giant's Deep]]'s core.

== Trivia ==

* Mallow is the common English name for the ''[[Wikipedia:Malva|malva]]'' genus of herbaceous plants, many of which are perennial.
